description: HPO terms for the 20 HA20 checklist features (schema_ha20_v3/v4), chosen by Claude on 2026-10-19 from the pinned HPO release by name and EXACT-synonym search and hierarchy checks (pipeline/extract/ontologies.py). 'observed' is the term a phenopacket may assert when the checklist item is observed; null where the item is a composite whose observed state cannot be pinned to one term (the specific feature rows carry it instead). 'excluded' lists every term a phenopacket may mark excluded when the item is explicitly absent. Flagged for review by Jimmy or the panel; not a pre-registered choice.

gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation.note: Gastrointestinal inflammation; Gastrointestinal ulcer is not its descendant, so both are excluded

arthritis or arthralgia.note: Arthralgia/arthritis is the combined term; Arthritis and Arthralgia are not its descendants

uveitis or other ocular inflammation.note: Inflammatory abnormality of the eye; Uveitis is a descendant

skin lesions (rash, folliculitis, erythe.note: Inflammatory abnormality of the skin is the common ancestor of the three; exclusion is limited to the three named lesions

autoimmune thyroiditis.note: Hashimoto thyroiditis (children of Autoimmunity and Thyroiditis); HPO has no separate 'autoimmune thyroiditis' term

cytopenia (autoimmune).note: Autoimmune cytopenia; autoimmune haemolytic anaemia and thrombocytopenia are descendants

central nervous system involvement.note: Morphological central nervous system abnormality (exact synonym 'Abnormality of the central nervous system'); observed CNS involvement is carried by the specific feature rows

elevated inflammatory markers (CRP/ESR).note: Elevated circulating C-reactive protein concentration; Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate (no common parent below Increased inflammatory response, which is not their ancestor)

autoantibodies (ANA/other).note: Autoimmune antibody positivity; Antinuclear antibody positivity is a descendant

interstitial lung disease.note: Abnormal pulmonary interstitial morphology (exact synonym 'Interstitial lung disease')
